contentHtml:
It is the primary duty of a brand or business service to maintain its business reputation in online platforms. Online platforms are unpredictable and can either ruin or revolutionize the company’s name. One has to be very careful while they choose the content to impress the audience and be ready to remove all the negative reviews. Delete negative reviews form google is a dutiful task and hence to be truthful no digital company can remove them completely. But, what they do is push down negative reviews and delete certain reviews that are contradicting the brand’s popularity from the consumer feedback sites.

These negative reviews and comments that are published in the review sites to defame the company are called ‘negative links’. As one must know that the competition in every field is increasing per day. None stick to ethics and that is the bitter truth. Hence, negative links posted shall destroy the competitor’s popularity. The best ORM service provider company like EON8 works as a team with different online business reputation maintenance and develops positive reputation tools.

EON8 aims in customer satisfaction. Hence, negative link removal plays a vital role here. For that very reason, what we do here is, efficiently manage reviews. We stack negative reviews with pleasant ones. Many businesses are not aware of the impact a review can have on their product or on the business. We’ve heard stories about losing a high score, business deal, or at the worst, losing customers over reviews. We don’t prefer that to happen because these reviews about the product or service may not even be true or relevant. They could be set into motion by some competitors.

According to various sources, some of the negative platforms which links are removed are:

  • WhoScammedYou.com
  • TheDirty.com
  • WebActivism.com
  • ScamBook.com
  • Exposes.net

These platforms allow customers and competitors to post negative comments that may cause slander to the product or business. With more and more comments and reviews like these, the positive outlook of people shall be erased. EON8, the best in digital marketing, works as a team to remove these reviews and develop a positive reputation for the company.

Some of the steps we follow are:

We try to push down the negative search results and reviews from the immediate reach of the audience. One would look for the reviews on the first page but not move to page number 3 or 4 for that matter. We push down these reviews. The ORM team of EON8 works hard to do these steps as it is not easy. they start with Google, yahoo bing, and all these pages and more. We also scrutinize the content of media and blogs.

Removing links from all the blogs and websites. This is because companies like EON8 know the mindset of people who would also read blogs and other websites along with reviews. So, the removal or deleting of the reviews becomes very important for the maintenance of online reputation.

And mostly to create a good impression on the brand, it is very essential to respond to every review, besides the negative links, be it positive or negative, and acknowledge even simple greetings or thanks for the positive feedback. This polite gesture would impact the attitude of the readers. Nonetheless, the important trait of any of the best ORM companies would be the patient and effective handling of such comments, which as one of the Online Service Providers EON8 never fails at.

No brand or business would like to have negative links or reviews floating online that will affect the mindfulness of the customers negatively by removing consumer complaints.
